blurb: Guests take a hot air balloon ride over North Georgia, seeing sights like Lake Lanier, Stone Mountain, Kennesaw Mountain, the Atlanta skyline, and the Blue Ridge and Appalachian mountain ranges. Wildlife such as deer, red-tail hawks, cranes, and blue herons may be seen. Flights are available year-round with spring noted as a particularly good time for smooth rides and scenery.
